title: IT Infrastructure Service Desk Agent
description:
**Company Description**  

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.


In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.


In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6\.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description** **Job Title: Service Desk Engineer**  

**Work Location: Coimbatore, India**  

**Reporting to: Service Desk manager**  

**Mode of work: Permanent role**  

**Shift Timings: 12PM – 9PM or 3\.30PM – 12\.30AM**  

  

**Job Description**  

  

Are you passionate about IT and eager to grow your career in a dynamic, international environment? Join our Service Desk team in Coimbatore, India, where you’ll be the first point of contact for IT support across Europe, we´re looking for services desk.  

As a Service Desk Engineer, you’ll support over 20,000 users across 500 sites in Europe, ensuring smooth operations for our laboratories, offices, and VIP users. You’ll handle a wide range of IT issues, from Microsoft 365 to workplace hardware, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality service.

  

You will support our internal users across Europe from Coimbatore.  

  

**How can you help us?**  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide 1st line IT support for end users across Europe.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to: Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint) Windows 10/11Identity \& Access Management Printing and patching (desktop/server) Application triage and routing Register, classify, and follow up on tickets using internal processes.
* Escalate complex issues to 2nd line support when needed. Contribute to documentation, knowledge base articles, and service catalog improvements.
* Identify and document workarounds and recurring issues.

 **Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree or comparable education  

  

**Experience: 3 year\+** Basic experience in a Service Desk or IT support role is expected.

* Candidates must possess strong communication skills in English, French, and Spanish.
* Solid troubleshooting skills, especially with Windows and Microsoft 365\.
* A strong customer service mindset and initiative to resolve issues efficiently.
* A proactive, “can\-do” attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

**Personal Skills:** Team Player, Smart worker, Quick learner, Willingness to work in off business hours with On\-call setup in needed.  

**Nice to have:** Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, or networking.  

Familiarity with BMC Helix ticketing system. ITIL Foundation certification. Knowledge of Azure, SCCM, or Intune. Windows Patching management for end user devices

**What else should I know?**  

This is a fantastic opportunity to build your IT career in a highly collaborative, multilingual environment. You’ll be part of a team that values continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing. If you're motivated by problem\-solving and thrive in a fast\-paced support role, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Technical support
description:

✔ Knowledge of **ServiceNow** and **Jira** Ticketing Tools

* Provide regular status updates to clients regarding issue resolution.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
**Powersonic – Join Us in Powering the Future!**

Our mission at Powersonic is to help power the products of the future and make everyone fall in love with great hardware, great engineering, and great design. This mission is super exciting, but there’s still a lot to do — and that’s exactly where you come in!

**Role Description**

This is a full\-time, on\-site role as an **IT Support \& Application Development Engineer** in **Coimbatore**.

You will be responsible for providing hands\-on IT support to end users while also developing, enhancing, and maintaining in\-house business applications. This role is ideal for an IT professional who can independently troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and user issues while also contributing to application development and database\-related activities.

**You will:**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and other IT hardware.
* Diagnose and resolve Windows operating system, application, driver, and network connectivity issues.
* Handle user requests and incidents through the ticketing system and ensure timely resolution.
* Support Microsoft 365, user accounts, access rights, email, antivirus, endpoint security, patching, and periodic backups.
* Develop, enhance, test, debug, and maintain in\-house applications and internal business tools.
* Translate business requirements into practical application solutions.
* Prepare basic technical documentation, test cases, user guides, and release notes.
* Work with databases for queries, reports, data corrections, and routine maintenance.
* Maintain IT asset, software license, configuration, and inventory records.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for repairs, AMC, procurement, warranty claims, and technical support.
* Provide on\-site IT support at office and plant locations when required.
* Support users across the assigned shift and respond to urgent IT issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT processes, security practices, system reliability, and application workflows.

**Coordinate with:**

* IT Manager / Hiring Manager to prioritize IT support and application development activities.
* Internal users and department heads to understand and resolve IT requirements.
* Software and hardware vendors for technical support, repairs, AMC, procurement, and warranty matters.
* Application users to gather requirements, test enhancements, and implement improvements.
* Cross\-functional teams to develop solutions that improve business processes and operational efficiency.

**You have:**

* Strong hands\-on knowledge of desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral troubleshooting.
* Experience with Windows OS installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and common business applications.
* Basic knowledge of LAN, Wi\-Fi, IP configuration, switches, routers, printers, and shared network resources.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language or development stack such as **C\#/.NET, Java, Python, PHP, or JavaScript**.
* Experience with web or desktop application development.
* Good understanding of SQL, including queries, joins, basic stored procedures, and reporting.
* Basic understanding of Git and software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Good communication skills in English and Tamil.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities between IT support requests and application development activities.
* Ability to work independently and provide a service\-oriented experience to internal users.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline such as **B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./BCA/MCA**.
* **3–4 years of relevant experience** covering IT support and application development.

**Extra points if you also:**

* Have experience working in a manufacturing, engineering, electronics, or IT services environment.
* Have experience supporting ERP applications.
* Have experience with SQL Server or other relational databases.
* Have experience with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems.
* Have experience with network troubleshooting and endpoint security tools.
* Hold certifications such as **CompTIA A\+, Microsoft, or networking certifications**.
* Have experience developing or supporting internal business applications.
* Have experience supporting users across multiple office or plant locations.

**Why you'll love working with us:**

* Work with a global and multicultural engineering and technology team.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to both IT infrastructure and business application development.
* Work directly with different functions to build practical technology solutions.
* Get exposure to manufacturing, ERP, database, and enterprise IT environments.
* Build your career across both IT support and application development.
* Grow in a collaborative, technology\-driven, and quality\-focused environment.

**Sounds like you? Let's chat.**

**Work Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**Working Hours:** 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM  
**Travel:** Local travel to office/plant locations may be required  
**Joining:** Immediate requirement

At Powersonic, we take personal matters very seriously and strive to be neutral in our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other legally protected characteristics. We pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

* Health insurance

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a skilled and proactive **IT Support Engineer** with 4 years of hands\-on experience in troubleshooting, maintaining IT infrastructure, and providing technical support to end users. The ideal candidate should have strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a customer\-oriented mindset to ensure smooth IT operations across the organization.

**Technical Support \& Troubleshooting:**

* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support for hardware, software, network, and system issues.
* Diagnose and resolve system, application, and connectivity problems within defined SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or vendors when necessary.
* Support remote users via VPN, remote desktop, or helpdesk tools.

**System \& Network Maintenance:**

* Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Perform routine maintenance on systems, servers, and backups.
* Assist in installation, configuration, and updates of operating systems, antivirus, and business applications.
* Support cloud\-based tools such as Microsoft 365, Cloud Workspace, or Azure AD.

**Asset \& Access Management:**

* Maintain IT inventory records for systems, peripherals, and licenses.
* Manage user accounts, permissions, and security settings (Active Directory, email, etc.).
* Ensure compliance with company IT and data security policies.

**Documentation \& Reporting:**

* Maintain detailed documentation of incidents, resolutions, and system configurations.
* Generate regular reports on IT performance, ticket trends, and system uptime.

**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement:**

* Work closely with internal teams to support infrastructure and technology projects.
* Suggest and implement improvements for system performance and IT processes.
* Train end\-users on best practices and new tools or updates.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in IT support or systems administration.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and/or macOS environments.
* Experience with networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), printers, and shared drives.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems.
* Very good understanding of cybersecurity and backup solutions.
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
* **Requirements**
* CompTIA A\+ / Network\+ / Security\+
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Cisco CCNA (preferred)
* Must be willing to work in rotational shifts: **8:00 AM – 5:00 PM** and **1:00 AM – 10:00 PM**.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* ITIL Foundation Certification

Cisco CCNA (preferred)
